model.name: gazebo
model.axes: x east, y north (entrance at -y), z up; origin = centre on ground

shows.title: Rainbow Chase
shows.description: Rainbow colors rotating around the gazebo by angle, with a slight height shift

shows.title: Rafter Spiral
shows.description: A comet runs from each rafter's wall end toward the ring, staggered per rafter so it spirals; ring has a rotating tail; the 72" rails pulse; the rest dim blue

shows.title: Wipe Up
shows.description: A color wipes up the whole structure by height, then the next color

shows.title: Twinkle
shows.description: Random white / ice-blue / warm sparkles on a dim blue base

shows.title: Breathing
shows.description: Each member group breathes in its own color, phase-offset

shows.title: Fire
shows.description: Fire effect rising up each post, glowing embers on the rest, warm ring

shows.title: Christmas
shows.description: Red/green alternating, swapping every 0.5 s with white sparkles

shows.title: Candlelight Dinner
shows.description: Warm amber (~2200 K) glow, independent gentle flicker, brighter posts, dim overall

shows.title: Starry Night
shows.description: Deep blue base, slow white/pale-blue twinkles, three shooting stars running up rafters into the ring (at 3 s, 9.5 s, 15 s)

shows.title: Slow Ember Glow
shows.description: Warm-white breathing wave (10 s) rising from posts to ring

shows.title: Aurora
shows.description: Drifting green / teal / purple waves around by angle and height

shows.title: Golden Hour
shows.description: Slow gradient shift amber to rose to soft violet and back, with a small height offset

shows.title: Eye of Sauron
shows.description: Ring is a yellow-white slit pupil with orange-red glow; rafters are red-orange flames fading outward; walls are dim pulsing red embers; a bright beam sweeps around the rafters at 2 s and 12 s

shows.title: Lantern Fireflies
shows.description: 16 warm-yellow fireflies drift around the structure and blink slowly
